card.name: Words introducing a time span
card.fires_on: Words that open or complete a span of time, such as 'years' after a number, 'duration', 'during', 'from' before dates, or 'until'. The next word is expected to be a number or time period.

modes.label: Duration wording
modes.description: The word 'duration' or 'years' where a length of time is being stated.
modes.example: Use the lowest effective dosage for the shortest possible<< duration>>.

modes.label: During / from / until
modes.description: Linking words that introduce a period, such as 'during' or 'from' before dates.
modes.example: Females of reproductive potential must use 2 effective forms of contraception or continuously abstain from heterosexual sex<< during>> and for 4 weeks after last dose

modes.label: Reign dates
modes.description: A word before a range of years in a historical passage.
modes.example: The Hundred Years' War began in the reign of Edward III, who was the King of England<< from>> 1327 to 1

card.writes: It seems to push toward starting a new number or name and away from time-unit words like months and years.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up a length or span of time, just before the actual period is given.
